meta.name: switch-clients
meta.description: Switch between existing customer engagements and triage competing needs. Use when context switching causes confusion; requires engagement records and preserves one client per write.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在多个客户项目之间快速切换并理清谁先谁后
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时服务多个客户,常被来回切换搞得手忙脚乱
copy.tagline_en: Move between multiple client engagements and sort out which needs come first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several clients and lose track when switching between them

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你已有的客户合作记录之间来回切换,并对互相竞争的需求做优先级分诊;每次写入只保留一个客户。若合作记录或访问权限缺失,它会如实报为限制,而不是凭空新建客户档案。
howto.when: 当客户之间的上下文切换造成混乱时会触发;前提是已有合作记录。若由 @fde 调用,它会复用对方当前的脱敏数据包和范围,不重新走一遍设置和提问。

say.text: 在 A 客户和 B 客户之间切换,接着上次的进度继续
say.note: 基于已有合作记录切换,不新建档案

say.text: 这两个客户的需求撞车了,帮我判断先做哪个
say.note: 做竞争需求分诊,每次只写入一个客户

say.text: 列出当前有哪些客户合作记录可用
say.note: 缺失或无权访问的记录会报为限制

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude switches between your existing customer engagements and triages competing needs, keeping one client per write. If engagement records or access are missing, it reports that as a limitation rather than inventing a portfolio.
howto.when_en: Triggers when context switching between clients causes confusion. It needs existing engagement records; when called by @fde it reuses that run's current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Switch between client A and client B and continue where we left off
say_en.note: Uses existing engagement records; no new records created

say_en.text: These two clients' needs collide — tell me which to do first
say_en.note: Triages competing needs, one client per write

say_en.text: List the customer engagement records currently available
say_en.note: Missing or inaccessible records are reported as limitations
